label: GOD_4 wills the esse of each distinct caused recipient, from rational giving
description: Given a GOD_4 g with will and a distinct effect x in act as to esse, the causal part of supreme goodness makes g a universal cause of esse. The GOD_4 intellect premise provides that same g's intellect. Thus the rational giving bridge covers x, and the recipient application supplies willing x its esse. Causation of x follows already from the universal coverage. This concerns distinct effects and leaves the self-case separate.
